# FaktumAI

> Bilingual website focused on software products, AI-assisted development, technical project expertise, and a content section covering news, analysis, interviews and tool reviews. Finnish is the default language and English content is available under /en/.

## Site (English)

- URL: https://www.faktum-ai.com/en/
- Language: English (en)
- Sitemap: https://www.faktum-ai.com/sitemap-index.xml
- Topics: https://www.faktum-ai.com/en/topics/
- Finnish edition: https://www.faktum-ai.com/

## Important areas (English)

- Home: https://www.faktum-ai.com/en/
- News: https://www.faktum-ai.com/en/news/
- Projects: https://www.faktum-ai.com/en/projects/
- About: https://www.faktum-ai.com/en/about/

## Content types

- /en/news/ — AI news and regulatory updates
- /en/analysis/ — In-depth analysis (markets, infrastructure, business models)
- /en/interviews/ — Interview summaries
- /en/tools/ — Tool reviews for builders

## Editorial line

Journalistic, technical, source-backed. Not hype. Claims and uncertainty are separated. Raw third-party material is rewritten as FaktumAI analysis. Articles share the same slug as the Finnish edition where both exist.
